e.title: **美国联邦公报的**全文检索接口****：**每天发布**的规则、**拟议规则与**通告**都可**按词与**机构**检索****：`federalregister.gov/api/v1`——**⭐ 本次实测**不**带密钥即可用**（**返回 **200**）**；**⭐ 以**「**flood insurance**」**检索得 **7,832 份文件**，**最新一份的发布日期逐字为 **2026-09-10****；**⭐ 以**「**Federal Insurance Office**」**检索得 **234 份**，**含逐字题为**「**2026 Report on the Effectiveness of the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program**」者**；**⭐ 可**逐字段挑选**返回内容**（**`title`／**`publication_date`／**`agencies`／**`html_url`／**`type`**）**
e.title_en: A full-text search interface over the United States Federal Register, where rules, proposed rules and notices published every day can be queried by term and by agency: it works without a key, a search for flood insurance returns nearly eight thousand documents with the newest published yesterday, and a search for the Federal Insurance Office returns a few hundred including this year report on the terrorism risk insurance programme.

e.summary: **Federal Register API**（美国联邦公报的公开接口，`federalregister.gov/api/v1`）**是一个**把**每日发布的监管文本**做成**可检索数据**的接口****——**本次实测**：**不**带密钥、**不**需登录**即可调用**（**返回 **200**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 本次**以「**flood insurance**」**检索**，**得 **7,832 份文件**，**最新一份的发布日期逐字为 **2026-09-10**（**⭐ 即**前一天**）**，**逐字题为**「**Final Flood Hazard Determinations**」与**「**Proposed Flood Hazard Determinations**」**，**类型字段逐字为 **`Notice`**，**机构字段逐字为 **`Homeland Security Department/Federal Emergency Management Agency`****（**⭐ 即**机构**分父子两级**）**；**② **⭐ 以**「**Federal Insurance Office**」**检索**，**得 **234 份文件**，**并**逐字取到**三份近日文件的标题**（**含**「**2026 Report on the Effectiveness of the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program**」与**「**2026 Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Data Call**」**）**——**⭐ 即**美国**联邦保险办公室**与**恐怖主义风险保险**项目**的材料**是**公开可检索**的**；**③ **⭐ 可以**逐字段挑选**返回内容**（**`fields[]=` 逐字支持 **`title`、**`publication_date`、**`agencies`、**`html_url` 与 **`type`**）**——**⭐ 即**调用者**可以**把**响应体**压到**最小**；**④ **⚠️ 而**本次**试错路径**（`/documents/facets/agencies`）**返回 **404****——**⭐ 本词条**如实注明**这**是**本条的**路径错误**，**不是**对**该接口**能力的**判断**。**⚠️ 本次**只做**只读检索**。
e.summary_hk: **Federal Register API**（美國聯邦公報的公開介面）**是一個**把**每日發布的監管文本**做成**可檢索數據**的介面****——**本次實測**：**不帶密鑰、**不需登錄即可調用**（**返回 200**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**法規文本的可編程介面**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 以「**flood insurance**」檢索得 7,832 份文件**，**最新發布日期逐字為 2026-09-10**，**逐字題為 Final Flood Hazard Determinations 與 Proposed Flood Hazard Determinations**，**機構欄位逐字為 Homeland Security Department/Federal Emergency Management Agency**（**⭐ 機構分父子兩級**）**；**② **⭐ 以「**Federal Insurance Office**」檢索得 234 份**，**並取到三份近日文件標題**（**含 2026 Report on the Effectiveness of the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program**）**；**③ **⭐ 可逐欄位挑選返回內容**；**④ **⚠️ 本次試錯路徑 `/documents/facets/agencies` 返回 404**——**⭐ 這是本條的路徑錯誤**，**不是對該介面能力的判斷**。**⚠️ 本次**只做只讀檢索**。
e.summary_en: This interface **makes the daily output of the United States Federal Register searchable as data**, and was measured this round as callable with no key and no sign-in. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.** **Four things are worth reading: a search for flood insurance returned seven thousand eight hundred and thirty-two documents, the newest published the previous day, titled final and proposed flood hazard determinations, typed as notices and attributed jointly to the homeland security department and the emergency management agency, so agencies come as a two-level hierarchy; a search for the Federal Insurance Office returned a few hundred documents including this year report on the effectiveness of the terrorism risk insurance programme and this year data call under that programme, so material from the federal insurance office is publicly searchable; the response can be narrowed field by field, with title, publication date, agencies, link and document type all selectable, keeping the payload small; and a path this round tried by mistake returned not found, which this entry records as its own error rather than as a limitation of the interface.** **Only read-only queries were made this round.**
e.body:
**Federal Register API**（美国联邦公报的公开接口，`federalregister.gov/api/v1`）**是一个**把**每日发布的监管文本**做成**可检索数据**的接口****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。

**可核实信息（均本次只读调用实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 以「**flood insurance**」检索，**返回近八千份文件，**而**最新一份是**前一天**发布的****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**`documents.json`** 接口**返回 **200**、**2,838 字节**（**⭐ 已用 **`fields[]` 限定字段**）**、**`count` 逐字为 **7832****；**⭐ 最新三条逐字为题**「**Final Flood Hazard Determinations**」（**两条）与**「**Proposed Flood Hazard Determinations**」**，**发布日期逐字为 **2026-09-10****，**类型逐字为 **`Notice`****，**机构逐字为 **`Homeland Security Department/Federal Emergency Management Agency`****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**洪水保险**」**在美国**不是**一条**抽象政策**，**而**是**FEMA **不断发布的**具体裁定**，**且**这些裁定**在**发布次日**就**可以**被**程序取到**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 以「**Federal Insurance Office**」检索，**返回 **234 份**，**而**其中三份**逐字标题**说明**这个接口**能取到什么****——**⭐ 本次实测**逐字取到**：**「**Request for Expressions of Interest in Membership on the Federal Insurance Office**」**（**⭐ 标题**在后文**被截断**于其**咨询委员会名**）**、**「**2026 Report on the Effectiveness of the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program**」与**「**2026 Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Data Call**」**，**发布日期逐字为 **2026-03-25****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 RIAA 直接有用**：**⭐ 即**美国**联邦保险办公室**与**恐怖主义风险保险**项目的**年度报告与**数据要求**都可以**用**一条 **HTTP 请求**检索到**——**⭐ 而**这**正是**「**监管文本**」**从**新闻**变成**可检索事实**的一个例子**。**⭐⭐ ③ 返回字段**可以逐项挑选****——**⭐ 本次实测**逐字支持的字段含 **`title`、**`publication_date`、**`agencies`、**`html_url` 与 **`type`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**对于**要**写脚本**的人**，**「**响应体只有我需要的字段**」**意味着**更少的解析工作**与**更小的**出错面**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 一处**本次的**路径错误**如实记录****——**⭐ 本次**为取**机构分布**，**尝试了 **`/documents/facets/agencies`**，**返回 **404****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实注明**：**这**是**本条作者**对**端点路径的**猜测错误**，**不构成**对**该接口**是否存在**机构聚合能力**的判断**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fred]]、**[[eurostat]]、**[[data-gov-au]]、**[[data-europa]] 覆盖**经济与**统计数据接口**、**[[nfra-portal]]、**[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、**[[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]] 与**[[naic-financial-data-repository]] 覆盖**监管信息**（**⭐ 多为**人工浏览的**门户**）**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**每日监管文本**做成**可按词与**机构检索的**接口**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **监管文本**要**有**可检索接口**，**不要只**靠**门户浏览**；**② **检索时**要**能按**机构**过滤**（**⭐ 本条**机构字段**含**父子两级**）**；**③ **响应字段**要**可裁剪**；**④ **引用时**要**记下**检索词与**检索时间**（**⭐ 因**其结果**每天变化**）**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了**只读检索**（**未下载任何**文件正文、**未提交**任何注释、**未使用**任何密钥**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何文件**的法律效力**，**也**不主张**本次检索**穷尽**了**任何主题**。**② ⚠️ 本次**对**该接口**的描述**止于**本次实际用到的**端点与**字段**——**⭐ 其**完整能力**（**如**分面聚合）**本次**未核实**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**使用条款**与**频率限制**（**⭐ 本词条**不给出**任何**调用建议**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**与**任何**商业数据产品**存在**授权关系**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**本文中**逐字引用的**三份**保险相关文件的**具体内容**（**⭐ 本条**只记录**标题、**日期与**类型**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该接口**返回的是**美国联邦层面**的文件**，**不构成**法律意见**。
e.body_hk:
**Federal Register API**（美國聯邦公報的公開介面，`federalregister.gov/api/v1`）**是一個**把**每日發布的監管文本**做成**可檢索數據**的介面****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**法規文本的可編程介面**」**。

**可核實資訊（均本次只讀調用實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 以「**flood insurance**」檢索，**返回近八千份文件，**而最新一份是**前一天**發布的****——**⭐ 本次實測**：`documents.json` **返回 200、**2,838 位元組（**已用 `fields[]` 限定欄位**）**、**`count` 逐字為 7832****；**⭐ 最新三條逐字為 Final Flood Hazard Determinations（**兩條）與 Proposed Flood Hazard Determinations**，**發布日期逐字為 2026-09-10**，**類型逐字為 `Notice`**，**機構逐字為 Homeland Security Department/Federal Emergency Management Agency****——**⭐ 即**「**洪水保險**」在美國不是抽象政策**，**而是 FEMA 不斷發布的具體裁定**，**且**在發布次日**就**可被程式取到**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 以「**Federal Insurance Office**」檢索得 234 份**，**其中三份逐字標題**：**Request for Expressions of Interest in Membership on the Federal Insurance Office**（**標題後文被截斷於其諮詢委員會名**）、**2026 Report on the Effectiveness of the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program**、**2026 Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Data Call****，**發布日期逐字為 2026-03-25****——**⭐ 即**美國聯邦保險辦公室與恐怖主義風險保險項目的年度報告與數據要求**都**可用一條 HTTP 請求檢索到**。**⭐⭐ ③ 返回欄位可逐項挑選**（**逐字支持 title、publication_date、agencies、html_url 與 type**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 一處本次的路徑錯誤如實記錄**——**嘗試 `/documents/facets/agencies` 返回 404****——**⭐ 這是本條作者對端點路徑的猜測錯誤**，**不構成對該介面是否存在機構聚合能力的判斷**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[fred]]、[[eurostat]]、[[data-gov-au]]、[[data-europa]]、[[nfra-portal]]、[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把每日監管文本做成可按詞與機構檢索的介面**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **監管文本要有可檢索介面**；**② **檢索要能按機構過濾**；**③ **響應欄位要可裁剪**；**④ **引用時要記下檢索詞與檢索時間**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做只讀檢索**，**不主張**其任何文件的法律效力**，**也不主張**本次檢索窮盡了任何主題**。**② ⚠️ 本次**對該介面的描述止於實際用到的端點與欄位**，**其完整能力本次未核實**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其使用條款與頻率限制**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其是否與任何商業數據產品存在授權關係**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**文中逐字引用的三份保險相關文件的具體內容**（**只記錄標題、**日期與**類型**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該介面返回的是美國聯邦層面的文件**，**不構成法律意見**。
e.body_en:
This interface **makes the daily output of the United States Federal Register searchable as data**, at a public document endpoint that was measured this round as callable with no key and no sign-in. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.**

**Verified information, all from read-only calls made this round**: **first, a search for flood insurance returns nearly eight thousand documents and the newest one was published the previous day.** The document endpoint answered with a small payload because fields were selected explicitly, reporting a count in the thousands, and the newest three items were titled final and proposed flood hazard determinations, published on the tenth of September, typed as notices and attributed jointly to the homeland security department and the emergency management agency. **Flood insurance in that jurisdiction is therefore not an abstract policy but a stream of specific determinations, and each is programmatically retrievable the day after publication.** **Second, a search for the Federal Insurance Office returns a few hundred documents, three of whose titles show what the interface can reach**: a request for expressions of interest in membership of that office advisory committee, this year report on the effectiveness of the terrorism risk insurance programme, and this year data call under the same programme, all published on the same day in March. **For this project that is directly useful: the annual report and the data call of the federal insurance office and the terrorism risk insurance programme can be found with a single request, which is what turns regulatory text from news into retrievable fact.** **Third, the returned fields can be chosen one by one**, with title, publication date, agencies, link and document type all selectable, **which means less parsing work and a smaller surface for error for anyone writing a script.** **Fourth, one path error made this round is recorded plainly**: an attempt at an agencies facet path returned not found, **and this entry notes that this was the author mistaken guess at an endpoint rather than a judgement about whether the interface offers aggregation at all.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover economic and statistical data interfaces, and several regulator portals that are browsed by hand, **while this entry supplies an interface that makes daily regulatory text searchable by term and by agency. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: regulatory text should have a searchable interface rather than only a browsable portal; search must support filtering by agency, which here comes as a two-level hierarchy; response fields should be selectable; and any citation should record the query terms and the date, because the result set changes daily.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, only read-only queries were made**, no document body was downloaded, no comment was submitted and no key was used, **so no claim is made about the legal force of any document or about whether any topic search was exhaustive**. **Second, the description here is limited to the endpoints and fields actually used**, and the interface full capability, such as facet aggregation, was not verified. **Third, its terms of use and rate limits were not verified**, and no calling advice is offered. **Fourth, whether it has any licensing relationship with commercial data products was not verified. Fifth, the contents of the three insurance-related documents quoted here by title were not verified**, only their titles, dates and types being recorded. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the interface returns documents at the United States federal level and does not constitute legal advice.**
